intro: Se tino fou e fai polokalame. E fakatautau ne au te galuega talimalo server ASHIKA Network mo te lisi o server Minecraft SABALISU, kae e fai ne au te polokalame server mō Minecraft Storia.
about: E fou eiloa au, kae e tusi ne au a code i aso katoa kae e fakalei atu
E tusi ne au a **Python**, **Node.js** mo **C#**
E fakatautau ne au taku galuega talimalo server
E fiafia au ki fesili e uiga ki aku galuega io me ko te technology: fai mai fua te talofa i luga i te Discord
can_write: Mea e mafai ne au o tusi (fakatasi mo code fakavalevale)
anw_t: ASHIKA Network: server mai te 30 yen i te masina
anw_p:
Se galuega talimalo mō tino e manako o fakagalue se server kae se mafai o fakaaogā se tupe e uke.
Kamata mai te mea foliki, **mai te 30 yen fua i te masina**.
sab_t: SABALISU: se lisi o server Minecraft
sab_p:
Tuku tau server Minecraft ki te lisi kae sala ne tino ke tafafaga i ei.
E aoga ki tino tafafaga e sala ki se server mo tino e pule e manako o fakaasi atu olotou server.
storia_t: Storia: se polokalame server mō server Minecraft lasi
storia_p: Se fork open-source o Folia mō Minecraft 26.2. Mo te **Storia Cluster**, e mafai ne se lalolagi e tasi o galue i luga i ne server e uke i te taimi e tasi, kae e fesuiai a tino tafafaga i olotou vaegā e aunoa mo se loading screen.
storia_points: **Storia Cluster**: se lalolagi e tasi e fakasoa ne server e uke, mo fesokotakiga ne fakafuna
**Relay fakatalitali**: se relay lua e tausi ne ia se kopi kae ka sui ne ia te relay muamua māfai e galo
**Linear format**: e fakaaogā ne te lalolagi te ‘afa o te koga i te disk
**Lalolagi RAM**, **Tick Guard**, se plugin API mō fakamatalaga fakasoa, mo nisi mea
